capabilities: Set editor body and heading colours, font families, sizes, weights and small caps
Add configurable border dividers above or below each heading level
Style highlights, body links, emphasis colours and the manuscript scrollbar
Browse a live Lorem Ipsum preview in the Text Styling modal
Register as the typography companion for Forge-family host plugins
disambiguation: Not a Markdown text-formatting tool; it styles editor appearance — colours, fonts, sizes and divider lines — rather than rewriting content.
extras: Manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. Integration API details are in separate docs files (docs/timelineforge-formatting-api.md, docs/storyforge-formatting-api.md) not included in the README.
intentEvidence: It also soft-integrates with the Forge plugin family (storyForge, timelineForge, and others that adopt the formatting API)
problem: Obsidian has no built-in UI for granular editor typography such as per-heading fonts, sizes, colours, dividers and small caps.

relations.evidence: Registers as formatting companion; applies editor CSS vars; shared palette / sizes / scrollbar
Font catalogue, font picker, and face registration for the timeline rail

summary: Styling plugin that adds editor colour pickers, embedded fonts, heading dividers, a text-styling modal, and pairs with Forge-family plugins.
